name: Quiet
summary: Small, calm clusters in front of the speaker: no glow, no count-up, no whip cuts and never behind the head. The quietest look the planner draws.
use_when: an interview, a serious or sensitive subject, or a long take where the captions should support the voice and never perform
never_when: a hook, a list or a short punchy clip that needs the words to hit, or any video that should feel loud
